owner: coordinating agent; retained evidence belongs to repository owner
custody: Unpublished exact binary package and owner-only review inputs/private host receipts retained in dist until evidence replay dependency is retired by owner. measurement_limits: Path allocations are measured, not inferred from filesystem deltas. Concurrent host allocations and git-object growth are not attributed; source/documentation baseline allocation was not measured.
